field.representation: polynomial basis; coefficient of x^i is bit i

curve.model: binary Weierstrass y^2 + xy = x^3 + a*x^2 + b

factor_base.construction: retained explicit point-defined Koblitz factor base from growing_n_n61_probe/base_n61_K600.jsonl
factor_base.quotient_rule: signed Frobenius orbit quotient; signs and Frobenius multiplier coefficients in relation rows

point_decomposition.equation: S3 root-chain compact-orbit decomposition, then group lift to target
point_decomposition.implementation: table-driven S3 half-trace solver with normal-basis rotations and a canonical Frobenius-orbit root index

relation_collection.target_query: single supplied public point Q; target-dependent start is derived only from Q coordinates
relation_collection.rule: guided factor-base log-rank acquisition during target-independent preprocessing; direct compact-orbit relation search for target
relation_collection.duplicate_dependency_policy: incremental modular row echelon; each admitted relation group-lift verified
relation_collection.stop_criterion: recover all 600 factor-base orbit logs, then one target decomposition and scalar recovery

target_descent.policy: direct target decomposition and relation lookup; recover d from target relation and solved factor-base logs

implementation.snapshot: local source and release binary hashes retained in protocol.json
